name: Autoresearch propose/synthesize/reviewer failed → stamp agent.run.outcome=failed (lineage anchor)
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a′ — autoresearch run-failed mapping, anchor branch 2 of 2 (the run-entity-descended roles). Fires when autoresearch-propose, autoresearch-synthesize, or reviewer-autoresearch terminates with an involuntary failure (agent.loop.outcome in [failed, truncated]). Stamps agent.run.outcome=failed on the RUN entity so agent-run/04 transitions executing→failed; otherwise the failed loop wedges the chain (a failed propose/synthesize/reviewer has no in-arc recovery) and the run hangs `executing`.

ANCHOR (agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id): these roles descend through the RUN-entity-fired iteration driver (rule 05), which threads run-loop-entity-id into propose/synthesize related_loops; rule 07 carries it to reviewer-autoresearch. They carry NO agent.run.entity-id (the run entity has no bare agent.run for the inherit path). This mirrors autoresearch/08's success-stamp anchor. The baseline (which carries agent.run.entity-id, not lineage) is the sibling rule 12. The agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_gt 0 guard ensures the stamp subject resolves (defends the C1 garbage-literal-subject class — the same bug that hung autoresearch in 4a when the success stamp's anchor wasn't threaded).

Companion to autoresearch/11-loop-failed-pause (operator chain.paused.marker, untouched). autoresearch-execute stays EXCLUDED — budgeted loop-failure via rule 04b keeps the run executing. The failed source loop is retained as an immutable reply fact. Only the failed-run origin handoff requests a user-facing summary; execute failures remain budgeted and excluded.

metadata.anchor: agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id — threaded by rule 05 (propose/synthesize) + rule 07 (reviewer). Mirrors autoresearch/08's success-stamp anchor. Baseline is the sibling rule 12 (agent.run.entity-id).
metadata.anchor_guard: agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_gt 0 ensures the stamp subject resolves (C1 garbage-literal-subject defense).
metadata.budgeted_exclusion: autoresearch-execute is NOT here — budgeted loop-failure via rule 04b keeps the run executing.
metadata.reply_contract: Failed run forwards the full source loop ID to its canonical origin; no direct orphan coordinator is published.
metadata.anchor_fence: Exactly one source run anchor is required; ambiguous multi-run values never use first-value selection for reply handoff.
